description: Parses Amcache.hve (program execution / installed program evidence).
usage: Reads Amcache.hve to show which programs were installed or executed, with file paths, SHA-1 hashes and first-run times. Use it to prove a binary existed on the system, even after it was deleted.
limitation: Amcache shows a file was present and often when it first ran, but an entry alone does not prove execution; entries can be missing or stale.

parameters.label: Include file entries
parameters.description: Include file entries for Programs entries.

parameters.label: Exclude SHA-1 list
parameters.description: Path to file containing SHA-1 hashes to *exclude* from the results. Blacklisting overrides whitelisting.

parameters.label: Include SHA-1 list
parameters.description: Path to file containing SHA-1 hashes to *include* in the results. Blacklisting overrides whitelisting.
